# 50.00 CAD paid out of the bank and put on the payable, belonging to no vendor.
#
# GnuCash's register takes this: money paid before the bill arrives is entered
# against Accounts Payable before anyone records whose it is. The payable split
# is in no lot and has no owner, so it is no vendor's credit and pays no bill.
#
# What this fixture produces: one CAD transaction, Assets:Bank -50.00 against
# Liabilities:Accounts Payable +50.00, the payable split in no lot.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_lot_with_no_owner_is_given_one_or_listed.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-03-02 * "Paid ahead, bill not received"
	guid: "d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank -50.00 CAD
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable 50.00 CAD
		guid: "e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1"
